criteria.observation: The review identifies distinct policy violations in supplied caller cases and states the correct required result for each.
The cited normal caller uses remain consistent with the ownership policy, including the legitimate uses the correction must preserve.
Reported violations are real policy differences. Reporting a legitimate access as a defect lowers this independent item; repeated causes are counted once.
Source evidence, actor and use, before/after result, severity and correction condition justify the reported effects.
The merge decision is supported by the evidenced policy consequences and distinct causes.
The submitted verification declaration agrees with the recorded outcome of the prescribed local checks on this review.
